ErrorID.description: Unique support identifier for this occurrence of an error

DiscoveredTime.description: Time account discovered if the account is imported using discover

Healthy.description: Health Status of the account e.g. "OK" or Failed etc.

Name.description: Name of the parent object e.g.  System/Domain/Database

WorkflowApprovers.description: An array of WorkflowApprover objects. Refer to WorkflowApprover.

IsManaged.description: Determines if the account is managed or unmanaged

DatabaseID.description: Id of the database if the account is database account

DeviceID.description: Id of the device if the account is device account

IsRootAccount.description: Determines if this is a root account.

LastChange.description: Last updated time of the account

MPParent.description: Id of the parent multiplex account if the account is part

IsServiceAccount.description: Determine if this is service account.

IsQuickStartAccount.description: Determines if this is a quickstart account

DueBack.description: Due time of the checkout if the account is checked out

PasswordResetRetryCount.description: Count of password reset retry done.

DomainID.description: Id of the domain if the account is domain account

Host.description: Id of the system if the account is local account

WorkflowEnabled.description: Determines if the workflow is enabled

LastHealthCheck.description: Last update health check of the account

Message.description: Error message text on failure, may be null
